description: Categories of regulatory or normative authority that can issue obligations (Layer 1).

terms.definition: Statutes or regulations specifically governing AI systems (e.g. EU AI Act).
Laws governing the processing of personal data and the rights of data subjects (e.g. GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA, LGPD).
Standards and regulations covering the security of information assets (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001).
Regulation specific to financial-services entities (e.g. DORA, PCI DSS, supervisory rules).
Regulation specific to health data and healthcare providers (e.g. HIPAA).
Regulation specific to education providers and learner data.
Cybersecurity-specific regulation and supervisory expectations (e.g. NIS2, NIST CSF).
Authority bound to a particular sector outside the categories above.
Voluntary or contractually-required industry standards (e.g. ISO/IEC 42001, SOC 2).
